newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shun Tak expects to axe 50-60 employees.
newsitem.headline: Shun Tak expects to axe 50-60 employees.

text.p: Property and shipping group Shun Tak Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it expected to dismiss 50 to 60 employees after the recent withdrawal of two jetfoils from service due to lower-than-expected market demand.
The company had withdrawn two jetfoils from its Hong Kong to Macau route last month as market growth had gone below expectation, spokeswoman Betty Lim said by telephone.
"It'll mean having to make some staff redundant. But at this stage we are still working out the redundancy plans and we haven't got actual figures," she said.
"We estimate that it'll only affect between 50 to 60 staff in total," she added.
Lim said the company had yet to decide when to execute the redundancies, and declined to disclose how much the move would save Shun Tak.
The two laid-off vessels were still held by Shun Tak, she said.
